ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) surface area with a high white-to-black pixel ratio estimated at 85:15.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white central and lateral regions; continuous low-intensity black border mapped along the trailing edge; concentrated dark pixel clusters at distal lobe tips; central vertical dark streak extending from the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 35-40 degrees and moderate bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the full span of the trailing edge with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical convexity; left lobe displays a steeper upward sweep toward the tip, while the right lobe exhibits a more elongated, gradual convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Primary vertical linear low-intensity mark located to the left of the central notch; faint horizontal linear pixel disruptions visible on the mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized dark scarring and pigment density at both lobe tips; healed vertical linear mark near the peduncle-fluke interface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive contrast boundary between the white interior surface and the continuous, heavily serrated black trailing edge.
